content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I have reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a few adjustments before signing:
- The relevant clause requires the Client to submit Change Requests without limit. To provide clarity, I propose that the Client may submit Change Requests up to three (3) times per Milestone, with any additional requests compensated at the rates set forth in the applicable SOW.
- The relevant clause allows only the Client to terminate the agreement for certain failures without notice or payment. I suggest adding that either party may terminate the agreement upon thirty (30) days written notice, and that the Client shall pay the Developer for all services performed and expenses incurred up to the effective termination date.
- The relevant clause makes the Works a “work made for hire” and transfers all copyright to the Client immediately, regardless of payment. I propose that the Works remain the Developer’s property until full payment of all Fees and any applicable Bonus is received, at which point the Developer will assign all copyright and intellectual property rights to the Client.
- The relevant clause requires the Developer to transfer all Works to the Client at the date of termination, even if payment is outstanding. I recommend that the Developer shall transfer all Works to the Client only after the Client has paid all undisputed Fees due under the agreement.

Thank you for considering these modifications. I look forward to finalizing the agreement.

Best regards
